No expectation is predicted for the real ones: their verdict is the measurement. All MIT, no install scripts, installed into a throwaway DSH_HOME and deleted afterwards; nothing is vendored (ADR-0004). The four fixture shapes and three synthetic failures are unchanged and marked real:false — they never count toward the denominator.
